tests.name: Random expressions
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(150)
def make(depth):
    if depth == 0 or random.random() < 0.3:
        return [str(random.randint(-20, 20))]
    op = random.choice('+-*/')
    left, right = make(depth - 1), make(depth - 1)
    if op == '/':
        right = [str(random.choice([-3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3]))]
    return left + right + [op]
exprs = [make(4) for _ in range(40)]

tests.name: 10 000 tokens
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1500)
tokens = [str(random.randint(-100, 100))]
while len(tokens) < 10000:
    tokens += [str(random.randint(-100, 100)), random.choice('+-')]
